verdict.rationale: Wrike documents no-code automations, natural-language generation of automation rules, and Wrike agents that handle everyday tasks such as triaging, risk assessment, and task execution. Together these cover setting up automations that work autonomously, though only through marketing-level vendor claims. missing for 10: detailed docs on triggers, schedules, or background execution behavior; independent or hands-on corroboration that agents and automations run unattended.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Connect Wrike to your apps, build no-code automations, and run end-to-end workflows from one secure platform.
Build workflows with Wrike agents and let them handle your everyday tasks.
allowing teams to build custom AI agents that handle triaging, risk assessment, and task execution.
